svg.text: One horizontal lane per subsystem. No wires cross lanes; the shared mux select bus (right of MUX A/B) is the only multi-lane element.
Lane 1 · JOG HUB PCB (DWG1569 JOGB Assy)
Lane 2 · TOP BUTTON PCB (DWX2306 KSWB · ~13 buttons)
Lane 3 · HOT CUE + LOOP + MEMORY clusters (incl. DWS1365 KSWB 1/2 · ~12 buttons)
Lane 4 · PITCH FADER (100 mm linear pot · 3 wires)
Lane 5 · JFLB DISPLAY BOARD — plain-LED reuse only (DWG1568 JFLB · VFD glass DARK in v0.1)
Lane 6 · DISCRETE FRONT SWITCHES (direct GPIO, internal pull-ups)
Lane 7 · OEM 12 V LED RAIL (CUE / PLAY / LOOP ring indicators)
POWER TREE · v0.1 = USB-bus only (no OEM PSU)
single tie point at USB-C return; analog ground for fader
kept on the same star but routed separately on the carrier PCB
• 3.3 V CMOS GPIO · NOT 5 V tolerant
• USB-C → host PC, class-compliant USB-MIDI via TinyUSB
• ADC1 + curve-fitting cal handles pitch fader (Lane 4)
• Native TOUCH_PAD6 on GPIO 6 = optional cap-touch (Lane 1)
• Avoid strap pins (0, 45, 46) and JTAG (39..42 if used)
• GPIO 18 reserved spare for MUX C (3rd mux) if button count grows
• GPIOs 22..34 unused on the N16R8 footprint
• Carrier PCB sits in the footprint of removed DWX2305 MAIN
